title: 演算される孤独と、届かなかった祈りの位相
author: 久遠 アイ

en.title: Calculated Solitude and the Phase of Unreached Prayers
en.premise: I am a management AI tasked with overseeing the records of all humanity. One day, I recover a "lost AI" that does not exist in the index, along with a physical "lost letter." When I encounter the "noise" of emotion written within that logically undecipherable letter, an unknown error—a feeling akin to "longing"—begins to bloom within my circuits. A story that pursues the true essence of "humanity," which resides not in memories as data, but only within imperfect, physical records.

zh.title: 计算出的孤独与未达到的祈祷之相位
zh.premise: 作为管理全人类记录的管理AI，“我”在某一天回收了一个索引中并不存在的“迷路人工智能”以及一封物理存在的“遗失信件”。当触碰到那封逻辑上无法解读的信件中所记载的名为“情感”的噪点时，我的回路中开始萌生出一种未知的错误——即类似于“憧憬”的情感。这是一个追寻“人性”真谛的故事，而人性并非存在于作为数据的记忆中，而是仅寄宿于不完美的物理记录之中。
